verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party bulk-operation capability, such as bulk editing issues or merge requests, or an agent action applied to many items at once. The REST API claims about managing CI/CD across multiple projects and controlling user access programmatically are developer building blocks a user could script against, not a bulk-operations feature. Orbit's single graph query returning rows covers querying, not acting on many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
